profile.headline: Hands-on Software Developer and Manager with expertise in modern front end technologies and user interface development.
profile.summary:
An experienced, Software Engineer with 15 years of experience coding as well as managing teams in building highly-interactive, high-visibility customer-facing applications for desktops, mobile and tablets. Expertise includes user interface development, JavaScript MVC frameworks and responsive web design.
  * Software Design and Architecture
  * User Interface Design and Development
  * Data Visualization and Charting
  * Managing and mentoring effective and collaborative Teams
  * Agile Software Development, Project Management
  * JavaScript MVC Frameworks, AngularJS, React Native, React, Redux, ES6, Node.js, npm, jQuery
  * CSS3, HTML5, Bootstrap, Responsive UI, Accessibility Standards
  * Java, ActionScript, Flex, Flash, HighCharts
  * API Design, XML, JSON, REST, GraphQL
  * Single-Page (SPA) Applications, Rich-Media Applications
  * TV, Video, Multimedia. Educational Software and Games

positions.title: Senior Manager, Web Development
positions.description: Led the development of top strategic web applications on the etrade.com website which have direct impact on the company’s revenue goals by attracting new investments. Managed multiple development teams in designing and developing applications utilizing JavaScript MVC frameworks, AngularJS, Node.js, HighCharts, Twitter Bootstrap, accessibility standards, and responsive design for desktop, mobile, and tablets. Oversaw scheduling, budgeting, resourcing and development of multiple critical projects and delivered on-time and on-budget. Coordinated cross-functional teams. Established and enforced reusable designs, coding standards, and best practices which streamlined team efficiency and product quality.

positions.title: Manager, Web Development
positions.description: Led front-end development teams building interactive data-driven web applications utilizing jQuery, Backbone.js HTML5, and REST APIs. Evaluated project scope, effort and schedule; assigned development tasks and supervised design and development. Evaluated new technologies, including Node.js based dynamic PDF generation API, charting and data visualization libraries, and provided recommendations based upon measurable criteria.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed a team of developers and performed lead architect and developer roles. Built a custom Object-Oriented MVC JavaScript framework and utility libraries. Managed a team of 12 engineers in building E*TRADE’s public website for desktop computers as well as the dedicated mobile version of the website.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed data driven web applications using JavaScript, ActionScript, Flash, Flex and AJAX for investing, trading and retirement planning. Designed and developed video players, widgets and single page rich internet applications. Led development of Retirement Planning Calculator, including Object Oriented MVC framework, architecture, client-server communications, and Model, Controller and Charting modules.

positions.title: Sr. Flash Developer
positions.description: Developed client and server side applications for interactive “experiments” for online course/homework company. Experiments allow up to 500 students to simultaneously participate in a simulated online marketplace.  Designed and developed client user interfaces in Flash and ActionScript and maintained and enhanced server side written in Java.

positions.title: Sr. Game Programmer
positions.description: Developed Flash based user interface and controls for Internet Browser, Instant Messenger, and Videophone for safe children's internet experience. Also programmed children's chat room with animated avatars and multi-user online checkers game in Shockwave using Object-Oriented Lingo programming language.

positions.title: Sr. Multimedia Design Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed online and CD-ROM based multimedia e-learning courseware for various clients using Macromedia Director.  Developed an interactve CGI-based web site in Perl.  Performed Software Quality Assurance and Metrics tracking for the first commercial Space Imaging Satellite.  Managed and coordinated a team of ground crew simulation operators.

positions.title: Sr. Multimedia Programmer
positions.description: Programmer for the Joey Award winning "Internet the City" multimedia CD-ROM title. Implemeted significant performance increases.  Implemented video player for playback of Quicktime movies. Built multiple versions maintaining single code base.

positions.title: Multimedia Programmer
positions.description: Programmer and Producer for interactive multimedia CD-ROM learning game titles: Math Ace Jr., Bit-Bot's Math Voyage, and Franklin's Activity Center.  All games were developed  in Macromedia Director using Object-Oriented Lingo.

volunteerExperiences.description: Led teams of volunteers to Rancho Santa Marta in Mexico. The teams taught classes in Computers, Agriculture, Welding and Mechanics to the children at this orphanage in Baja California.

projects.title: E*TRADE Analyst Recommendations by TipRanks
projects.description: Managed the front end development of Analyst Recommendations built using AngularJS, including responsive UI and accessibility design, API design, and Agile/Scrum team management. Project released on-time and on-budget.

projects.title: E*TRADE Adaptive Portfolio
projects.description: Managed the front end development of E*TRADE Adaptive Portfolio, a highly strategic achievement for the company in the Robo Advisor space and a critical, high visibility project.
